criteria.text: A parent can dispatch 50 sibling reader sessions and all 50 make observable progress without deadlocking.
criteria.test_id: issue-1164-c1: admits 50 sibling readers from one parent without deadlock

criteria.text: Two or more concurrent top-level parents can each await nested children without circular semaphore starvation.
criteria.test_id: issue-1164-c2: waiting parents yield capacity to nested children

criteria.text: The behavior works consistently across every supported model/provider path, not only OpenAI.
criteria.test_id: issue-1164-c3: schedules all provider identifiers through the same global capacity

criteria.text: The default concurrency target is 50 and can be lowered through configuration without code changes.
criteria.test_id: issue-1164-c4: defaults to 50 and honors a lower configured limit

criteria.text: Provider throttling queues/retries affected work without blocking unrelated providers.
criteria.test_id: issue-1164-c5: provider backpressure blocks only the affected provider

criteria.text: Interactive sessions remain responsive while a large swarm is active.
criteria.test_id: issue-1164-c6: round-robin roots admit an interactive turn before queued swarm work

criteria.text: Cancelling a parent or child releases all associated scheduler capacity.
criteria.test_id: issue-1164-c7: cancellation removes queued work and releases active capacity

criteria.text: Scheduler diagnostics identify active and queued work and why a turn is waiting.
criteria.test_id: issue-1164-c8: diagnostics expose ownership and queue wait reasons

criteria.text: Unit tests cover flat concurrency, nested concurrency, cancellation, fairness, and provider-specific backpressure.
criteria.test_id: issue-1164-c9: combined lifecycle preserves capacity across nested backpressure and cancellation

criteria.text: A live behavioral test, gated behind an environment flag, dispatches a real 50-reader swarm through the engine/API surface and asserts that children actually enter model execution and complete or return results. Record the sandbox run in `docs/ai/runs/` per the repository verification gate.
criteria.test_id: issue-1164-c10: 50 real reader sessions enter model execution and return output
